title: Survey ground off the lidar, line 17
about: Ground-level survey areas that sit steadily off IPR's 2023 lidar where no surveyed rail runs and DMR 5G (2009-2013) disagrees with IPR too, so the ground changed between the two lidars. The survey may be newer than both; the orthophoto shows which. Answers become data/truth.json surveyGround (python -I tools/survey_ground_answers.py).
options: The survey is right: the ground changed since the lidar
The lidar is right: move the survey to it
